name: Vance AFB
description: Home of the 71st Flying Training Wing. Vance AFB conducts specialized undergraduate pilot training, training hundreds of pilots annually in the T-6 Texan II and T-38 Talon.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate.

gates.name: Main Gate
gates.notes: Primary 24/7 access with visitor processing. Visitor passes available after hours at Hairston Gate.

gates.name: Mendez Visitor Control Center (Bldg 241)
gates.hours: Mon-Fri 0700-1500 (closed 1200-1230 for lunch); closed last Friday of month at 1200, federal holidays, and wing down days
gates.notes: Day passes and visitor registration. REAL ID required. Phone: 580-213-7410.

gates.name: Hairston Gate
gates.notes: 24/7 gate. Visitor passes available after hours when VCC is closed.

resources.name: Crosswinds Club & FSS Dining
resources.description: Vance AFB has no traditional DFAC. Dining at Crosswinds Club, Falcon's Nest Bowling Alley, Cactus Lanes Grill, Silver Wings, and The Grounds.
resources.hours: Crosswinds Club lunch Mon-Fri 1100-1400; Falcon's Nest and Silver Wings hours at vancefss.com

resources.name: Vance Main Exchange (BX)
resources.description: Full-service Exchange with retail, services, shoppette, beauty salon, dry cleaner, and coffee shop.

resources.name: Tinker Federal Credit Union
resources.description: On-base federal credit union on base with ATM.

resources.name: Bradley Fitness Center
resources.description: Main fitness facility with cardio, weights, group exercise, basketball, racquetball, and lap pool.

resources.name: Unaccompanied Housing / Dorm Management
resources.description: Dormitory management and assignments for student pilots and permanent party.

resources.name: Cherokee Inn / Rec Lodge (AF Lodging)
resources.description: Official temporary lodging including Rec Lodge (2-3 bedroom suites with full kitchen, washer/dryer). 24-hour front desk options available.
resources.hours: Lodging desk open 24 hours daily; check-in 1400, check-out 1100 (Cherokee Inn); Rec Lodge Mon-Fri 0800-1700

resources.name: Military & Family Readiness Center (M&FRC)
resources.description: Relocation assistance, financial counseling, employment support, family programs, and Total Force readiness. Right Start Newcomer's Orientation held monthly.

resources.name: 71st Force Support Squadron (FSS)
resources.description: Full MWR, dining options, fitness, lodging, recreation, and family support programs.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 0730-1630; facility hours on FSS website directory

resources.name: Outdoor Recreation
resources.description: Equipment rental, Rec Lodge amenities (courtyard, playground, dog park, pavilion), and recreational programs.
resources.address: Bldg 790, 426 Goad St, Vance AFB, OK 73705

resources.name: Vance Golf Course
resources.description: 18-hole golf course with pro shop and dining.

resources.name: 71st Medical Group
resources.description: Primary care, specialty clinics, and TRICARE services.

resources.name: Vance AFB Commissary
resources.address: 216 Fields St, Bldg 410, Vance AFB, OK 73704

resources.name: Falcon's Nest Bowling Center
resources.address: 308 Sawyer Rd, Bldg 345, Vance AFB, OK 73704

resources.name: Visitor Control Center
resources.description: Visitor passes and base access. REAL ID required.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 0700-1500 (closed 1200-1230 lunch); closed last Fri of month at 1200, federal holidays, wing down days

resources.name: Finance Office (Comptroller)
resources.description: Military pay, travel vouchers, and finance customer service.

resources.name: Military Personnel Flight (MPF)
resources.description: ID cards, DEERS, assignments, and personnel actions.

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage and birth certificates if applicable, and travel receipts for finance settlement.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining squadron. After-hours visitor passes at Hairston Gate. Cherokee Inn: 580-213-7358.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Cherokee Inn (580-213-7358) or Rec Lodge for initial arrival. Dormitory Management for unaccompanied housing. Family housing through privatized housing office.

sections.title: Sponsor Program
sections.body: Contact M&FRC at 580-213-6330 if no sponsor assigned before departure.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 71 FSS, M&FRC, and official Vance sites for in-processing and pilot training support.
